A look of its own: darker studio palette, a red-orange accent and a reworked header.

**Look**
- New studio palette: dark graphite surfaces instead of mid grey, white type, plugins framed by a thin line, hairlines between title bar, header and waveform.
- Accent is now red-orange (#FF6526) everywhere: playhead, meters, active buttons, logo, app icon and file-type icons.
- Header: the volume is a longer, thin fader centred between the transport and the quick buttons, with the level in dB always shown next to it. File details and time are set in a monospaced font. The play button is a little smaller so it weighs like previous/next.

Nothing else changed: same layout, plugins, shortcuts and settings.
